content.text: Route-service's own methods (`RouteRepository.findAll`, `findById`) went from about 1 ms to about 1 s, and `queryAll` is 3 s. Next I'll check the DB-layer spans and route-service's pod and container metrics to tell an in-process slowdown from a resource problem.

input.query: SELECT 'nor' p, span_name, count(*) n, avg(duration)/1e6 avg_ms, quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6 p95 FROM normal_traces WHERE service_name='ts-route-service' AND span_name LIKE 'SELECT%' GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'abn', span_name, count(*), avg(duration)/1e6, quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6 FROM abnormal_traces WHERE service_name='ts-route-service' AND span_name LIKE 'SELECT%' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1

content.text: Every DB span in route-service slowed about 500–2000× (p95 0.1 ms → ~200 ms), while its HTTP and in-process layers are downstream of that. Next I'll check whether mysql's CPU or other services' DB spans moved too, to separate a route-service DB fault from a shared mysql problem.

input.query: SELECT 'nor' p, metric_name, attr_k8s_pod_name pod, count(*) n, avg(value) avg_v, max(value) max_v FROM normal_metrics WHERE metric_name ILIKE '%cpu%' OR metric_name ILIKE '%memory%' GROUP BY 1,2,3 UNION ALL SELECT 'abn', metric_name, attr_k8s_pod_name, count(*), avg(value), max(value) FROM abnormal_metrics WHERE metric_name ILIKE '%cpu%' OR metric_name ILIKE '%memory%' GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 2,3,1
